items.headline: Flood Advisory issued July 24 at 10:59PM AKDT until July 25 at 11:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is occurring.

* WHERE...Little Susitna River from the Parks Highway downstream.

* WHEN...Until 1100 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1054 PM AKDT, river gauge reports indicate rises in water
levels from heavy rain across the advisory area. Minor
flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.
- The crest is expected to occur near the Parks Highway
overnight tonight
items.areas: Lower Matanuska Valley; Southern Susitna Valley
items.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 24 at 3:15PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
A cold front is expected to move southeast from the Chukchi Sea
Saturday night into Sunday, northwesterly winds are expected to
increase across the Kotzebue Sound. Gusts on Sunday are expected
to be between 30 and 40 mph. With this, water levels could rise to
as high as 2 ft above the normal high tide line, with the highest
levels in the Kotzebue Sound.
items.areas: Kivalina and Red Dog Dock; Baldwin Peninsula; Northern Seward Peninsula; Shishmaref

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 24 at 3:15PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Another Arctic cold front is expected to move southeast from the
Chukchi Sea Saturday night into Sunday. Starting off, most of the
precipitation will be rain and then transition to snow Saturday
night into early Sunday morning. During this transition, there is
a slight chance for sleet and/or freezing drizzle to fall along
the eastern Arctic Coast. 2-4" of snow is possible in the Brooks
Range and a coating to 2" across the Arctic Coast.
items.areas: Central Beaufort Sea Coast; Central Arctic Plains; Central Brooks Range; Romanzof Mountains

items.headline: Flood Advisory issued July 23 at 1:44PM AKDT until July 25 at 12:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Yentna River.

* WHEN...Until noon AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water could enter a few low-lying cabins along the Yentna River,
particularly near Lake Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 139 PM AKDT, recent heavy rains have caused rapid river
rises. Minor flooding is expected to continue, especially
along the Yentna River near Lake Creek.
